exposure: antepartum hemorrhage due to total placenta previa
outcome: conversion from spinal anesthesia to general anesthesia
cohort: A 37-year-old female G4P10021 at 37+2 weeks gestation with moderate confirmed COVID-19 infection, antepartum hemorrhage due to total placenta previa, a history of cesarean section, and an ovarian cyst.
finding: A pregnant woman with COVID-19, placenta previa, and other comorbidities experienced acute respiratory distress and neurological deterioration within 40 minutes of spinal anesthesia during a cesarean section, necessitating conversion to general anesthesia.
mod_finding: Conversion from spinal anesthesia to general anesthesia was required during a cesarean section due to acute respiratory and neurological complications.
